name: Pickled rau móp
summary: Pickled rau móp. Báo Quốc tế says the whole plant is used, and that young leaves and tips are the part put in brine. The same account also names stir-fry, sour soup, and salads.
origin: Củ Chi. Báo Quốc tế calls rau móp muối chua a specialty of the district and also pairs it with steamed beef.
howToEat: Eat the pickle. Báo Quốc tế also says rau móp is stir-fried with garlic, cooked as sour soup, steamed with chicken, or tossed with chicken, shrimp, or beef.
Báo Quốc tế also pairs the pickle with steamed beef. That pairing stays with the other uses.
